en: Sepia-toned photograph showing a large outdoor crowd seated closely together, many wearing early-20th‑century style hats and coats. They face a stage or open-air structure built in a rustic, stone-like style, with an arched tower or church-like façade to the right and trees surrounding the area. The image appears aged at the edges, typical of vintage postcards. No visible printed caption or text appears on the front.
